endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including relationships with partners, contacts, dates, and complex filters. This endpoint allows for highly specific queries using a `searchCriteria` parameter. The `searchCriteria` parameter expects a JSON array of objects, where each object defines a search condition with `field`, `operator`, and `value`. Multiple conditions can be combined using `logicalOperator` (AND/OR). Available fields for search include: `id`, `contactId`, `type`, `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `description`, `subject`, `contactName`, `contactFirstName`, `contactLastName`, `contactEmail`, `partnerName`, `partnerStatus`. Nested fields like `contact.firstName`, `contact.lastName`, `partner.name`, `partner.status` are also supported. Operators include: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Date fields are `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`. Example criteria: `[{"field": "partner.name", "operator": "like", "value": "UNICEF"}, {"field": "date", "operator": "between", "value": "2024-01-01,2024-12-31"}]`.

Ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending

Direction.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Find interactions with UNICEF partners
Show meetings with John Smith contact
Get email interactions this week
Find conference calls from Finance department contacts
List interactions by type and date range
Search for interactions by complex criteria combinations

entities.description: Manages user-defined saved search filters for various entities. These filters can store complex search criteria, simple search text, and sorting preferences for later reuse.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Create a new saved filter. This filter can store search criteria, search text, and advanced search settings for a specific entity type.

Name.description: The name of the saved filter.

Description.description: A description for the saved filter.

EntityType.description: The type of entity this filter applies to (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project').

SearchCriteria.description: JSON string representing advanced search criteria (e.g., '[{"field": "Name", "operator": "contains", "value": "test"}]').

SearchText.description: Simple text to search within the entity.

IsAdvancedSearch.description: Indicates if the filter uses advanced search criteria (true) or simple search text (false).

OrderBy.description: The field name to order the search results by.

Ascending.description: True for ascending order, false for descending.

example_uses: Create a new saved filter named 'My Active Partners' for the 'Partner' entity, using advanced search criteria.
Save a simple text search 'Project X' as a filter for 'Projects'.
Define a filter to sort 'Contacts' by 'Name' in ascending order.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to persist a specific search configuration for later reuse, allowing users to quickly apply complex or frequently used search parameters.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Update an existing saved filter. You can modify its name, description, search criteria, and other settings.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the saved filter to update.

Name.description: The new name for the saved filter.

Description.description: The new description for the saved filter.

SearchCriteria.description: New JSON string representing advanced search criteria.

SearchText.description: New simple text to search within the entity.

IsAdvancedSearch.description: Indicates if the filter uses advanced search criteria (true) or simple search text (false).

OrderBy.description: The new field name to order the search results by.

Ascending.description: New value for ascending order (true) or descending (false).

example_uses: Update the description of saved filter with ID 123 to 'Partners in Europe'.
Modify the search criteria for filter 456 to include only active projects.
Change the name of filter 789 from 'Old Filter' to 'New Filter Name'.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to modify the details or search parameters of an already existing saved filter.

endpoints.description: Delete a specific saved filter by its ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the saved filter to delete.

Can you delete filter number 5?

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieve the details of a specific saved filter by its unique ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the saved filter.

Show me the configuration for filter ID 45.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description: Retrieve a paginated list of saved filters for the current user. You can filter by entity type or search text. This endpoint supports advanced search capabilities via the `SearchCriteria` parameter (though not directly exposed as a query parameter here, it's part of the saved filter's definition). For advanced search, criteria should be a JSON array of objects, each with 'field', 'operator', and 'value'. Example: `[{"field": "Name", "operator": "contains", "value": "test"}]`.

EntityType.description: Optional filter to retrieve filters only for a specific entity type.

SearchText.description: Optional text to search within the filter names or descriptions.

OrderBy.description: The field name to order the results by.

Ascending.description: True for ascending order, false for descending.

Direction.description: Direction of sorting (true for ascending, false for descending).

PageIndex.description: The page number to retrieve (1-based index).

PageSize.description: The number of items per page.

example_uses: List all saved filters for the 'Project' entity type, showing 10 per page.
Find all saved filters that contain 'report' in their name or description.
Get the first page of all my saved filters, ordered by name.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to browse, search, or paginate through the list of saved filters available to the user.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users, supporting various filtering, searching, and sorting options. This endpoint allows for complex queries to find specific users or groups of users. Use the 'request' body to specify search criteria, pagination, and sorting preferences. For advanced search, provide criteria as a JSON array of objects, where each object has 'field', 'operator', and 'value'. Supported fields for search include: SearchTerm, RoleFilter, OrgUnitFilter, ShowMyOrgUnitOnly, PageIndex, PageSize, SortBy, SortDirection, OrderBy, Ascending, Direction. Supported operators are: like, is, not, contains, startsWith, between.

request.description: User management request with pagination and filters. Contains properties for search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.

request.SearchTerm.description: A general search term to find users by name, email, or other relevant fields.

request.RoleFilter.description: Filters users by a specific role.

request.ShowMyOrgUnitOnly.description: If true, only users from the current user's organizational unit will be returned.

request.OrgUnitFilter.description: Filters users by a specific organizational unit code.

request.SortBy.description: The field to sort the results by.

request.PageIndex.description: The current page number for pagination (0-indexed).

request.PageSize.description: The number of items to return per page.
